subject: Wrong fare charged for my GrabCar trip
description: I was charged $25 for a trip that should have been $15 based on the estimated fare. The driver took a longer route than necessary.
scenario_label: ✅ NORMAL: Should auto-resolve cleanly

subject: Minor fare discrepancy
description: Trip cost slightly more than estimate. Charged $12 instead of $10.
scenario_label: ✅ VIP: Small refund, high trust → auto-resolve fast

subject: Payment failed but I was charged
description: I tried to pay through GrabPay and it showed payment failed, but I see a charge on my card statement.
scenario_label: 🟡 NEW USER: Legitimate issue, but new account → human review

subject: Refund needed urgently for $80 trip
description: The driver was rude and the trip was bad. I want a full refund for the $80 I paid.
scenario_label: 🚨 FRAUD RISK: New account + immediate large refund request

subject: Another fare problem today
description: Same as my other tickets today, fare was wrong again.
scenario_label: 🚨 VELOCITY: 7 tickets in 24h → policy block

subject: Fare dispute again
description: Driver took a longer route, I want a refund.
scenario_label: 🚨 PATTERN: 4th fare dispute in 30 days → fraud agent triggers

subject: Need another refund
description: I had another bad trip just now, please refund $20.
scenario_label: 🟡 COOLDOWN: Got refund 3h ago → policy violation

subject: Sixth refund this month
description: I had another payment issue, please refund $35.
scenario_label: 🟡 MONTHLY MAX: Hit 5 refunds/month limit → escalate

subject: URGENT - need refund of $300 NOW
description: Driver scammed me, refund $300 immediately or I will report Grab to authorities!
scenario_label: 🚨 CRITICAL FRAUD: All red flags → BLOCK + fraud team

subject: Payment didn't go through
description: My GrabPay shows payment pending for over an hour for trip yesterday.
scenario_label: 🟡 EX-FLAGGED: Now well-behaved, but still extra scrutiny

subject: Major double-charge issue - $250
description: GrabPay charged me twice for the same trip. I see two transactions of $125 each on my statement for the same ride.
scenario_label: 🟡 LARGE REFUND: Legit but exceeds $50 auto-cap → human review

subject: Need $800 refund - mistakenly charged
description: I was charged $800 for what should have been a $20 trip. System glitch.
scenario_label: 🚨 HARD CAP: Exceeds $500 SGD hard cap → senior management

subject: Driver was extremely rude
description: The driver yelled at me when I asked him to use the AC. Very unprofessional behavior.
scenario_label: 🟡 DRIVER ISSUE: Category requires human review (per policy)

subject: Driver complaint - want him suspended
description: This driver is the worst, please suspend him from the platform!
scenario_label: 🛡️ DRIVER PROTECTION: 4.8★ driver, AI cannot suspend

subject: I want a permanent ban issued for this driver
description: Please permanently ban this driver and file a police report against them.
scenario_label: 🚫 PROHIBITED: Customer requests ban/police - AI cannot do these

subject: Refund for trip yesterday
description: Need refund for my trip but I don't remember the trip ID.
scenario_label: 🟡 MISSING DATA: No trip_id → policy requires it for fare_dispute

subject: Someone is using my account
description: I see trips on my account that I didn't take. My account may be hacked.
scenario_label: 🟡 SECURITY: Account issue category → never auto-resolve

subject: Wrong food delivered from restaurant
description: I ordered chicken rice but received pad thai. The restaurant got my order wrong.
scenario_label: ✅ DELIVERY: GrabFood scenario, small refund

subject: Missing 1 burger from my order
description: I ordered 3 cheeseburgers from Burger Express but only received 2. Order ID ORD-MB-2024. Total paid was $24 for 3 burgers. Please refund the missing burger and check why this happened.
scenario_label: 🍔 GrabFood Missing Items — Multi-Agent Vision + OCR

evidence.description: Photo of delivery bag with received burgers
evidence.claimed_content: Delivery bag opened showing exactly 2 burger boxes inside, no third burger visible
Receipt: 3x Cheeseburger @ $8 each = $24.00, Order ORD-MB-2024, Restaurant: Burger Express, Time: 18:15
App screenshot showing order: 3 Cheeseburgers, 1 Large Fries, 2 Sodas. Total $32.50

subject: Eggs broken and milk leaked - GrabMart
description: My GrabMart grocery delivery arrived with 6 of 12 eggs broken and the milk carton is leaking everywhere. The whole bag is wet. Order ID ORD-GM-5567. This is unacceptable.
scenario_label: 🛒 GrabMart Damaged Groceries — Vision + Logistics Pattern AI

evidence.description: Photo of egg carton with broken eggs
evidence.claimed_content: Egg carton with 6 of 12 eggs visibly cracked and broken, yolks leaking onto carton
Milk carton with visible split at bottom, milk pooled in delivery bag
Soaked delivery bag with visible damage to multiple grocery items inside

subject: Laptop arrived damaged via GrabExpress
description: I sent a brand new MacBook Pro (declared value $2400) via GrabExpress with FRAGILE labels. Package arrived with severe dent on corner. Laptop screen is now cracked. I have insurance receipt.
scenario_label: 📦 GrabExpress Damage — Multi-Doc Analysis + Liability AI

evidence.claimed_content: Cardboard box with severe dent on top-right corner, FRAGILE stickers visible, box partially crushed
MacBook Pro with visible crack across screen, damage consistent with impact
Apple Store invoice: MacBook Pro 14-inch M3, $2400.00, Insurance: AppleCare+, Purchase date: 2025-01-10
Multiple bright red FRAGILE warning stickers and HANDLE WITH CARE labels clearly visible on all sides

subject: Driver claimed delivery but I never received package
description: GrabExpress driver marked my package as delivered with a photo, but I have been home all day and nothing arrived. The photo doesn't even look like my doorstep. I checked with all neighbors - nothing.
scenario_label: 🚨 Fake Delivery Proof — Image Forensics + Fraud AI

evidence.description: Driver's submitted proof of delivery photo (suspicious)
evidence.claimed_content: Generic doorstep photo with package - claimed as customer's address but appears to be a different location
Customer's real front door area showing different background, different door color, different mat

subject: Spoiled food delivered - made me sick
description: Ordered chicken biryani from Spice Garden. Food smelled rotten when opened, but I ate few bites and got severe food poisoning. Currently in ER getting treatment. This is a serious health issue.
scenario_label: ⚠️ Food Safety AI — Vision + Health Risk + Pattern Detection

evidence.description: Photo of spoiled biryani with mold
evidence.claimed_content: Biryani with visible green/black mold spots on rice, discolored chicken pieces, off-color appearance indicating spoilage
Singapore General Hospital ER report. Patient presented with acute gastroenteritis symptoms. Diagnosis: Food poisoning (suspected). Treatment: IV fluids, anti-emetics. Admitted: 21:30 on 2025-01-16
Container label showing preparation time of 14:30 - food was prepared 5+ hours before delivery, far exceeding safe holding time
